rules.note: Energy labels are editorial planning metadata, not measured audio energy.

lanes.label: Quiet Road / Restful Field
lanes.direction: Warm road, meadow, inn, rain, dawn or village travel. Gentle but still melodic from the opening.

lanes.label: Skybound Flight
lanes.direction: Flight above cloud seas, floating islands, airship routes or mountain thermals. Buoyant forward motion, soaring but non-fatiguing melody, rhythmic strings/guitar, optional light percussion. No trailer bombast.

lanes.label: Open-Sea Voyage
lanes.direction: Sailing from harbor into open water, wind filling sails, distant islands. Rolling 6/8 or flowing pulse, warm strings/guitar/accordion or flute, restrained nautical percussion. Adventure, not pirate battle music.

lanes.label: Deepwater Descent
lanes.direction: Diving beneath a fantasy sea, submerged ruins, glowing reefs or deep caverns. Fluid pulse, lower-register cello/bass, harp/piano/guitar motifs, mysterious but clearly melodic. Avoid pad-only ambience.

lanes.label: Traveler March
lanes.direction: A caravan, guild, festival procession or kingdom road march. Clear walking pulse, light snare/frame drum, rhythmic guitar/bass, strings and optional warm horns. Proud and exciting without military aggression.

lanes.label: Triumphal Return
lanes.direction: Homecoming, reunion, gates opening, banners and celebration after a long journey. Broad uplifting melody, warm strings and optional brass, strong forward cadence. Celebratory rather than battle-victory or cinematic trailer music.

lanes.label: Frontier Surge
lanes.direction: Entering a vast new region, racing across plains, climbing toward a pass or chasing the horizon. Heart-racing pulse, rhythmic guitar/bass and string movement, melodic JRPG exploration energy without EDM or combat intensity.

lanes.label: Night Wonder / Reflective Fantasy
lanes.direction: Starlight, aurora, moonlit city, reunion or farewell. Warm and dreamlike, but melody enters immediately and the arrangement still develops rather than remaining ambient.
